thread:
rachel_presales: CarterCorp asked for a tight artifact set for tomorrow's SIG review focused on encryption: clear statement on who can access key material, exportability for HSM keys, rotation defaults, and a 1-command POC they can run. Can security confirm what we can hand them quickly?
imelda_security: Short pack we can hand: 1) one-paragraph "who holds keys" (Redwood-managed vs BYOK), 2) explicit line: HSM-backed keys are non-exportable and attested by provider, 3) rotation defaults (Redwood-managed: 90d high-sec / 365d standard; BYOK: customer controlled), 4) redacted audit event example, 5) a single CLI smoke test for encrypt/decrypt when BYOK is in customer's account.

carter_cust: For the HSM attestation, can you name supported HSM vendors and whether you require customer certs? We use Azure Dedicated HSM and Thales on-prem.
imelda_security: We support AWS CloudHSM and Azure Dedicated HSM for hosted/dedicated modes. For on-prem Thales, our Private deployment includes an adapter but we require the customer's FIPS/attestation certs for vendor-level claims. We'll include vendor attestation PDFs where available.

dan_commercial: Procurement wants a single-sentence SOW snippet about costs for BYOK/HSM during the POC. Keep it nonbinding.
imelda_security: Suggested wording: "BYOK/import support is available for POC; on-prem HSM adapters may incur a one-time integration fee and a modest ongoing support add-on; exact fees sent by commercial team".

sam_ops: For the smoke test we'll provide an AWS CLI example that customers can run against a key in their own account (preferred) or our demo CMK. Single command example (we'll provide exact role/grant steps separately):
`aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/RedwoodPOC --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > ct.bin && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > pt.bin`
sam_ops: Note: with HSM-backed CMKs the ciphertext never reveals key material; HSM enforces non-export.

rachel_presales: Action items: @imelda_security prepare one-paragraph + redacted audit JSON, @sam_ops finalize CLI sample + quick grant steps, @dan_commercial draft the SOW line. I'll package and send to CarterCorp before noon. Carter, does that timeline work?

carter_cust: Works for us. If you can include the attested FIPS docs and an example audit event we can drop into our vendor review spreadsheet, that would be ideal.

redwood_deploybot: POC instance created: redwood-poc-carter-us-east1; demo CMK alias/RedwoodPOC provisioned with logging enabled.
